environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x trading platform deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Layer 4). PostgreSQL 14 database with application user 'trading_app' granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'trading' schema. WebSocket endpoint exposed directly. Session cookies set with SameSite=None for mobile app compatibility. No CSRF token validation on WebSocket upgrade.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA trading TO trading_app
